The midpoint update has AR coefficient r(u)=(1-u)/(1+u) and Gaussian innovation variance 1-r(u)^2, so every step-mixture preserves N(0,1); the first two Hermite eigenvalues are E r and E r^2 and autocorrelations are geometric. Strict convexity of r proves that randomization worsens linear IACT. For f=r^2, its second derivative changes sign at u=2. The supporting chord from t_B=1+2/B to B is tangent at t_B and its difference from f factors as (B-u)(Bu-B-2)^2/[(B+1)^3(1+u)^2]. I independently checked the symbolic factorization, both contact points and tangency. Convex-envelope Jensen/equality proves the unique optimal step law; no claim for fixed physical-time cost.
